public_rationale: The firm continued-use prediction is supported. Harvard respondents reported substantial generative AI use in April 2024, and the repeated UK survey documented continued widespread use through December 2025. These observations meet the early-resolution rule for persistence across academic periods. The hedged prediction about switching to open-source competitors is excluded from this outcome.
limitations: The evidence covers UK full-time undergraduates and respondents at one US institution, not every country.
Survey responses are self-reports; the Harvard sample has selection limitations.
This outcome establishes continued use, not indefinite future use, limited spending power, or open-source migration.
